posts.author: lildreidel
posts.body:
hello! i’m very new to the forums
I’m currently trying to make a teleportation hub in my game where you can tp to an area if you’ve unlocked the “bonfire”, a similar mechanic to bloodborne’s hunter’s dream rather than teleporting directly from the bonfire. I however cannot figure out the variables that need to be set, as well as for the choices to show up as you unlock them. Is this too complicated, or am i missing a plugin? Thanks for any help!

posts.author: rpgLord69
posts.body: Well the teleport is just a transfer player event that send you to the coordinates next to your bonfires. And your bonfires turn a switch or affect a variable when you activate them (or give you a hidden item). For the choices you could make a bunch of conditionals, but that's tedious. You could show the locations with hidden items and select item list. Or you can search for a plugin that allows conditional choices. Or even a fast travel plugin.

posts.author: Andar
posts.body:
as said above, there are many different ways to handle a transport network.
and we can't tell you what you did wrong without seeing what you did do.
the best way to get help is by providing a screenshot of the event you have so far with specific questions on what part you have problems with.

posts.author: ZombieKidzRule
posts.body:
Welcome to the forum!
If you search YouTube for something like RPG Maker MZ Teleport Tutorial you will find a bunch of videos explaining player transfers, variables, etc.
I even have a couple of tutorials that show one way to recreate the Set/Return to Portal functionality like in Morrowind and other games where the player can choose where to place transfer portals.
But you definitely don't need a plugin for simple teleporting/transfer mechanics.
Good luck on your projects!

posts.author: Arcaines
posts.body:
Depending the style of your game will require how your set up is.
I set up an event heavy teleport HUB but the teleport locations are linear so you can easily set up how you unlock them in order.
But if it's open world then of course that requires more eventing to be done. It can totally be done with events but it depends on how much work you want to put into it.
If you want a easy option then search for plugins for choices only to appear under set conditions.
